title: Optimal High-Order Methods for Solving Monotone Variational Inequalities
abstract: arXiv:2609.23557v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study second- and higher-order methods for solving smooth monotone variational inequalities (MVI). Monteiro and Svaiter (SIAM J. Optim., 2012) showed that a second-order method, NPE, converges at a rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1.5})$. For convex-concave minimax optimization, a subclass of MVI problems, Chen, Liu, Luo, and Zhang (COLT 2025) recently improved this rate to $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}( T^{-1.75})$. However, the result has a substantial gap compared to the lower bound of $\Omega(T^{-2.5})$ established by Chen et al. (2026). In this paper, we propose a novel second-order method that achieves the optimal rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2.5})$. Our algorithm also extends to higher-order methods: for any integer $ p \ge 1$, we obtain a $p$th-order method with a convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-(3p-1)/2})$, matching the known lower bounds and therefore establishing optimal rates across all orders.

translated_title: 求解单调变分不等式的最优高阶方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究用于求解光滑单调变分不等式（MVI）的二阶及更高阶方法。Monteiro和Svaiter（SIAM J. Optim., 2012）证明了一种二阶方法NPE以 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1.5})$ 的速率收敛。对于凸-凹极小极大优化（MVI问题的一个子类），Chen、Liu、Luo和Zhang（COLT 2025）最近将该速率改进至 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-1.75})$。然而，与Chen等人（2026）建立的 $\Omega(T^{-2.5})$ 下界相比，该结果仍存在显著差距。本文提出了一种新颖的二阶方法，达到了 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2.5})$ 的最优速率。我们的算法还可以扩展到更高阶方法：对于任意整数 $p \ge 1$，我们得到了收敛速率为 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-(3p-1)/2})$ 的 $p$ 阶方法，与已知下界相匹配，从而在所有阶数上确立了最优收敛速率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的二阶方法，在求解单调变分不等式时达到最优的 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2.5})$ 收敛速率，并可推广至任意 $p$ 阶方法，其速率 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-(3p-1)/2})$ 与已知下界相匹配，在所有阶数上建立了最优收敛率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel second-order method achieving the optimal $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2.5})$ convergence rate for monotone variational inequalities, which extends to $p$th-order methods with rate $\mathcal{O}(T^{-(3p-1)/2})$ matching known lower bounds, thereby establishing optimal rates across all orders.
